title: The latest signal
overview: Today’s index contains 240 recent records. The strongest signals span Consciousness / philosophy, Neuroscience, Quantum physics. Treat the ranking as a reading priority, not a verdict: preprints and ambitious theoretical claims still require independent scrutiny.

items.title: Reviewer #2 (Public review): Neural correlates of perceptual consciousness from within: A narrative review of human intracranial research
items.why_it_matters: Combining intracranial recordings with no-report paradigms and computational models offers the clearest path yet to isolating genuine neural correlates of consciousness from their prerequisites and consequences.

items.title: Quantum Interference and the Limits of Separability
items.why_it_matters: Abstract Quantum theory implies, and empirical evidence confirms, that while particles can exhibit wave-like behavior in interferometric experiments, this behavior is so limited as not to allow for third- and higher-order interference. The article at hand shows that this possibility-impossibility structure suggests the universal validity of a principle that regulates statistical correlations between spatiotemporally localized events, independently of the nature of the objects that may or may not partake in these…
